If the desklamp has already been observed on a surface such as a desk, side table, or dresser, go directly to that furniture and do not continue searching unrelated containers or blindly opening drawers. If the target object is not at the desklamp, first obtain and carry the target object to that furniture; if the target object is already at the desklamp, directly try to use the desklamp, and if the interaction is not accepted, ensure the target object is in hand and retry. After arriving, use use desklamp <id> with the instance ID to trigger the observation; do not use bare names or compound syntax, and do not treat the desklamp as a carryable object or navigation point. The desklamp is an interaction point fixed on furniture, not a carryable object or navigable location."},{"id":"T0173","english":"The environment models the desklamp as a fixed light source or fixed device; only the furniture where it is located can be a navigation target, and the desklamp itself cannot be the target of take or go to."},{"id":"T0174","english":"Do not try to take, move, or navigate to the desklamp.
